newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds higher in thin market activity.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds higher in thin market activity.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Monday amid very thin activity on account of holidays in many parts of Latin America for carnival.
"There is nothing happening today - the market is without operations," said a trader at a local bank. Few trades were recorded on screens.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 which is mainly traded abroad rose 1/4 to 90-3/4, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was $0.10 higher at 126.05.
Another trader said: "Even if the market is very slow it is holding up."
Traders predicted activity and price movement would remain thin through the session.
